notes.title: Join the Pre-Alpha Playtest!! 🎮
notes.notes:
Welcome to the playtest of the pre-alpha version of the game!

During this playtest you will be able to play the first level of the game completely with 4 characters.

The version of the game is still in early stages of development. It will be very helpful to know your impressions to improve the game and make decisions.

There will be things that will change when the game is released in its final version.
I will be updating this version with changes and content that will be added.

I hope you enjoy it and remember to add the game to your Steam wishlist!
